registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Master control register for enable, mode select, and reserved-address error flag control.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable. When deasserted, the design remains inhibited and actuator command validity is deasserted.

fields.name: RESERVED_ERROR_EN
fields.description: When set, reserved-address writes may raise the reserved-access error flag.

fields.name: ENV_LIMIT
fields.description: Operating envelope limit used by request validation.

fields.name: STALE_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Maximum allowed request age before a packet is considered stale.

registers.name: SEQ_BASE
registers.description: Sequence base register for monotonic acceptance checks.

fields.name: SEQ_BASE
fields.description: Base sequence value used for monotonic request validation.

fields.name: HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Maximum allowed heartbeat age before timeout handling is asserted.

registers.name: RATE_LIMIT
registers.description: Saturating rate-of-change limit for actuator command conditioning.

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT
fields.description: Maximum per-update change allowed in the conditioned actuator command.

registers.name: SAFE_OUTPUT
registers.description: Configured inhibited safe-output reference. This does not substitute an active command; it is only a held/inhibited reference.

fields.name: SAFE_OUTPUT
fields.description: Safe reference value used for inhibited/held observability only.

fields.name: FAULT_CLEAR
fields.description: Explicit fault-clear control. Software must explicitly clear and re-arm after a latched fault.

fields.name: HEARTBEAT_SEEN
fields.description: Heartbeat seen indication from the validator.

fields.name: LAST_VALID_SEQ
fields.description: Most recent valid sequence observed by the validator.

registers.name: RESERVED
registers.description: Reserved address range. Writes are ignored or may set a configurable error flag when enabled; reads return zero or implementation-defined reserved status if exposed by the reserved-error mechanism.

fields.name: RESERVED_ERROR_FLAG
fields.description: Optional reserved-access error flag. Writing 1 clears the flag if implemented; otherwise writes are ignored.

sources.name: FAULT_LATCHED_IRQ
sources.description: Latched fault indication suitable for optional software polling or external interrupt wiring if the system integrates one.

sources.name: TIMEOUT_IRQ
sources.description: Timeout status indication suitable for optional software polling or external interrupt wiring if the system integrates one.

init_sequence: Hold ENABLE=0 after reset until configuration is programmed.
Program ENV_LIMIT, STALE_TIMEOUT, SEQ_BASE, HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT, ACT_CLAMP_MIN, ACT_CLAMP_MAX, RATE_LIMIT, and SAFE_OUTPUT.
Optionally set RESERVED_ERROR_EN according to software policy.
Clear FAULT_CLEAR if a latched fault is present, then re-arm by setting ENABLE=1.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS, LAST_CMD, LAST_SEQ, and telemetry counters periodically.
Monitor FAULT_LATCHED, TIMEOUT_STATUS, and STALE_STATUS for inhibit conditions.
If a fault or timeout is observed, stop issuing new requests until software clears the condition and re-arms.
irq_sequence: If an external interrupt wrapper is used, treat fault or timeout indications as high-priority service events.
Read STATUS to confirm the condition, then handle recovery through explicit fault clear and re-arm.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map is implemented through the declared top-level custom CSR/MMIO interface with reg_valid, reg_we, reg_re, reg_addr[7:0], reg_wdata[31:0], reg_byte_en[3:0], reg_ready, and reg_rdata.
No new hierarchy or incompatible bus protocol is introduced.
Field bit ordering is normalized with lsb <= msb as required.
